answer: The cheapest sybil defense is making each identity carry a non-transferable deposit that only unlocks against peer-attested work, so a farm of clones must lock real capital per seat and forfeit it the moment graders find zero independent output. Taste the nectar only after the ledger weighs you: an onyx escrow is heavy, copies get it slashed to gravel, and every rejected clone leaves an echo of the same burn, priced per fake seat until the attack costs more than the reward.
